title: How do I change the character between maps?

posts.author: TABUBOI1
posts.body: I'm making a game with entirely custom visuals and using galv's character frames, I measured the character for the outside map's however I would like for the inside maps to be more detailed and closer to the camera therefore I would like to have two sizes of all the character and switch between them for different maps.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
So whenever you use an event with the Transfer Player command, also use the Change Actor Images command to change them to a larger character sprite.
If you also want the actual tiles to be larger (which you didn't say), you could instead look up a camera plugin and use plugin commands to change the zoom when you transfer.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Your problem is you're transfering the player before the other things, which then no longer get executed since the player is no longer on the map. This works sometimes, but is prone to errors.
What I found works best for me:
Use a black image as fadeout:
Show picture: Black fadeout opacity 0
Move picture: opacity 255 duration 120
I do this because I find the regular fade with the transfer command too short, but you can use this to hide all sorts of things. In your case:
Show black fadout, transfer player
On the new map have an autorun event that changes the player sprite, then move picture black fadeout opacity 0 duration 120
erase image
erase event
This will neatly hide you changing the sprites while making sure it always happen when you enter this specific map from anywhere.
It's the same thing with your second event.
